verdict.rationale: The office's own pages link 'Track Status' to a public application-status search on iprsearch.ipindia.gov.in with no account named on the entry (supp-2). Public search pages for existing trademarks and designs also appear in navigation (docs-1, docs-16, docs-6), so lookup-by-number and search flows are reachable without login. However, the core filing flow ('Comprehensive e-Filing Services') is not documented as having a keyless entry path, so only the adjacent status and search rails are evidenced as account-free. Missing for 10: documented account-free entry to the core e-filing flow, explicit published statement that no login is needed, hands-on corroboration of the file-number lookup.
